basis: GameStop’s March 24 earnings release was the earliest qualifying issuer communication found. Its consolidated GAAP statements report net sales of $1,104.3 million for the 13 weeks ended January 31, 2026 (Q4 FY2025), versus $1,282.6 million for the 13 weeks ended February 1, 2025 (Q4 FY2024). Sales fell 13.9%, below the $1,218.47 million threshold. The release gives both quarterly figures directly.

coverage.detail: March 25, 2025. The original Q4 FY2024 consolidated statement reported $1,282.6 million of net sales, matching the comparative figure in the FY2025 release.
September 9, 2025. The preceding earnings cycle reported Q2 net sales of $972.2 million and provided no Q4 FY2025 sales forecast.
October 7, 2025. The intervening warrant announcement specified distribution and exercise terms. It gave no quarterly sales figure.
December 9, 2025. The immediately preceding release reported Q3 net sales of $821.0 million versus $860.3 million and nine-month sales of $2,525.6 million. It gave no numeric Q4 sales guidance.
January 7, 2026. The CEO award announcement set market-capitalization and cumulative EBITDA targets. Its historical figures covered expenses and profitability. None established Q4 net sales.
January 8, 2026. The follow-up 8-K furnished the CEO option award agreement and gave no Q4 sales update.
January 30, 2026. CNBC’s published remarks from its interview with CEO Ryan Cohen described the size of a potential acquisition. The quoted remarks gave no Q4 sales estimate.

GameStop’s 2026 release archive lists the January 7 award and March 16 scheduling notice before the March 24 results. Searches for intervening preliminary results, updated guidance, investor presentations and public management calls found no earlier qualifying Q4 figure.
March 16, 2026. GameStop scheduled Q4 and full-year results for after market close on March 24. The notice contained no sales estimate.

The FY2025 10-K identifies the Q2 sale of Canada and the prior-year Italy divestiture and Germany closures. The earnings release compares consolidated sales as reported in each period. As a cross-check, FY2025 sales of $3,629.9 million less nine-month sales of $2,525.6 million equal the directly reported Q4 figure of $1,104.3 million.
EDGAR accepted the results 8-K with the earnings release as Exhibit 99.1 on March 24, 2026 at 16:02:55 Eastern.

publication_date_evidence: GameStop’s earnings release is datelined March 24, 2026 and states that the company released results that day. The same-day EDGAR acceptance independently confirms public availability.
